# Two worktrees of one repository share the build cache: the second restores
# outputs and reuses test results instead of running. The cache cannot
# restore an `uncached` output, so a target missing one runs. --force
# bypasses the cache, and --clean leaves it alone. Each target appends to a
# log beside the worktrees when its command runs.
cd repo
exec git init -q
exec git add .
exec git -c user.email=test@example.com -c user.name=Test commit -qm base
exec git worktree add -q ../wt
bit
exists deps/dep.txt

# build runs here to produce deps/, so smoke, which depends on it, cannot be
# planned as cached: its key needs build's result. Once build reproduces the
# other worktree's result, smoke reuses that worktree's run.
cd $WORK/wt
bit --plan
stdout '^ *build \+ '
stdout '^ *lib ⇣ .*\(cached\)$'
stdout '^ *check · .*\(cached\)$'
stdout '^ *smoke \+ '
! stdout 'smoke .*cached'

bit
stdout '^ *build ▶ '
stdout '^ *lib │ restore lib\.txt$'
stdout '^ *check · cached$'
stdout '^ *smoke · cached$'
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' $WORK/build.log
grep '\Arun\n\z' $WORK/lib.log
grep '\Arun\n\z' $WORK/check.log
grep '\Arun\n\z' $WORK/smoke.log
grep '\Ahello\n\z' dist/app.txt
grep '\Alib\n\z' lib.txt
exists deps/dep.txt

# With deps/ in place, a missing dist/ is restored, and plan and apply agree
# that smoke is unchanged.
rm dist
bit --plan
stdout '^ *build ⇣ .*\(cached\)$'
stdout '^ *smoke · '
bit
stdout '^ *build │ restore dist$'
! stdout 'restore deps'
stdout '^ *smoke · no changes$'
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' $WORK/build.log

# Restored files are copies, so changing one leaves the cache intact.
cp $WORK/repo/src.txt lib.txt
bit lib
stdout '^lib ⇣ '
grep '\Alib\n\z' lib.txt
grep '\Alib\n\z' $WORK/repo/lib.txt

bit --force lib check
stdout '^ *lib ▶ .*\(forced\)$'
stdout '^ *check ▶ '
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' $WORK/lib.log
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' $WORK/check.log

# --clean removes only this worktree's outputs; the cache restores them.
bit --clean
! exists dist
! exists lib.txt
exists $WORK/repo/dist/app.txt
bit lib
stdout '^lib │ restore lib\.txt$'
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' $WORK/lib.log

-- repo/.gitignore --
dist/
deps/
lib.txt
-- repo/BUILD.bit --
build = exec {
  command = "echo run >> ../build.log; mkdir -p dist deps; cat src.txt > dist/app.txt; echo dep > deps/dep.txt"
  inputs = ["src.txt"]
  outputs = ["dist/", "deps/"]
  uncached = ["deps/"]
}

lib = exec {
  command = "echo run >> ../lib.log; echo lib > lib.txt"
  outputs = "lib.txt"
}

check = exec.test {
  command = "echo run >> ../check.log; grep -q lib lib.txt"
  depends_on = [lib]
}

smoke = exec.test {
  command = "echo run >> ../smoke.log; test -f deps/dep.txt"
  depends_on = [build]
}
-- repo/src.txt --
hello
